description: This file is a Python module that acts as a shim to redirect imports from an old namespace (_tensor) to a new namespace (torch.distributed.tensor). It maintains backward compatibility and re-exports key functions and classes related to DTensor and distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents a device mesh topology for distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: Partial
classes.description: Placeholder or partial object related to tensor distribution.

classes.name: Placement
classes.description: Defines the placement of tensors or data in distributed setting.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard or partition of a tensor across devices.

methods.name: distribute_tensor
methods.description: Distributes a tensor according to specified placement.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Generates a tensor with random values.

methods.name: randn
methods.description: Generates a tensor with normally distributed random values.
